# ReviewRequirement

`schemas/records/review-requirement.json`

The review required for a subject (docs/design/m0/13 "The required review is a graph input"). It is both the params of a review_requirement node, a controller node with no inputs, and the conclusions of the result that node records: the fold refuses a review_requirement result whose conclusions are not its node's params. A review that declares a review_requirement input binds it: the claim fold refuses a requirement whose roster or definition version is not the review's. Comparisons are on the revision (roster and definition), never on a review's computation key.

## Fields of the document

| Field | Required | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `subject` | yes | [Name](records-receipt.md#name) | What is reviewed, named by the task's template (e.g. candidate). It names no tree, so a base move does not change the requirement and a valid carry-over survives it. |
| `roster` | yes | array of [RosterMember](records-review-node-params.md#rostermember) (minItems `1`) | The required reviewers, as a review node's roster (records/review-node-params), with the same checks. |
| `definition_version` | yes | string (minLength `1`, maxLength `128`) | The definition version of the review kind it requires. |
| `revision` | yes | integer (minimum `1`, maximum `9007199254740991`) | The requirement's revision for its subject; a roster change selects a new one (G6b). |

No other fields are allowed.
